summary: Wrote a nine-phase sequential plan (17 hours) for task 975 from the research report. It lands the refutation of the temporal edge at Base, proves the Boolean and box-cell edges by one parametric translation theorem, generates the edge table and proof-fragment listing, and leaves the temporal edges at the other three classes as conjectures proposed for a record of their own. The plan departs from the soundness-bridge-completeness method named in the task description, as research recommended; the reasoning is in its Decisions section.

artifacts.summary: Nine-phase sequential plan (17h): land the machine-checked refutation of the temporal edge at Base, prove the Boolean and box-cell edges by a parametric translation theorem over a Prop-valued cell calculus in FormalSystem with within-forms in BimodalLib, generate the edge status table and proof-fragment listing from kernel-checked rows, and revise docs and records.
